purpose: Formalize falsification in MPF as relational decoupling and research-debt reopening rather than as simple binary negation.
core_principle: Within the Mono-Process Framework, successful falsification is interpreted as the loss of the relational conditions required to maintain lawful closure.

interpretation.lawful_condition: A lawful condition exists only while sufficient relational support is maintained.
interpretation.successful_falsification: A successful falsification attack removes the boundary conditions required to sustain the local closure.
interpretation.decoupling_read: As supporting relations fail, the condition progressively decouples.
interpretation.symmetry_read: Increasing decoupling corresponds to increasing symmetry.
interpretation.return_condition: Complete local decoupling returns the condition to a symmetric condition and reopens research debt.

governance_consequence.promotion_non_permanence: Promotion within the program is never permanent.
governance_consequence.debt_reentry: Loss of sufficient relational support automatically re-enters the condition into research debt and a new induction cycle.

fundamental_principle.truth_read: Truth within MPF is dynamic rather than static.
fundamental_principle.maintenance_rule: A condition is maintained through continued admissible coupling.
fundamental_principle.recurrence_rule: Decoupling increases symmetry, and symmetry returns the condition to induction.
